{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert 'revenue' column to float, coercing errors to NaN
sales_df['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(sales_df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Check for any invalid conversions
print(f"Number of invalid revenue entries: {sales_df['revenue'].isna().sum()}")

# Verify conversion worked
print(sales_df[['revenue', 'converted']].head())"}
